text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Evening. Standing in corner of training track, Matikanefukukitaru looked strange.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: *staaaaare*

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*stare*...
...Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnh?! Dawn just broke a moment ago, when did it become evening?! My knees acheee?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu...!
You'll listen to me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I was actually in big trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Said it happened when she found lost friendship-boosting lucky item other day――

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
Safely recovered precious handkerchief!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now I can stay friends with everyone again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: 'Stay' friends...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes! Friendship couldn't exist without lucky item, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait. Are we... not friends without handkerchief?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's time you started believing.
In us... and in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
――And that's how they got angry with me!
No matter how much I think, still don't understand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Encounter born from blessed divine guidance, so why get angry...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...From lack of self-confidence, she seemed convinced she couldn't make friends without lucky items.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that caused misunderstanding with friends.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp, could misfortune have gathered in that classroom...?! Giving negative energy to everyone...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Couldn't watch her lose herself in confusion, shared thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: M-M-Meaning, being friends with everyone isn't thanks to lucky item...?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yet I said friendship was all thanks to lucky item――

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And that made them mad...?
I see, is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: No, wait, that's strange! Why would anyone be friends with me?!
choice_data_list: Because you have your own charm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek! No way, eeeeeeek?!
Impossible short of natural disaster happening?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-That makes zero sense, uh, really... huh, eh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, she froze again.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: *staaaaaaaare*
choice_data_list: Run a bit to clear head?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Trust... everyone...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, yes!
I can definitely trust everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trust... ah, I understand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I denied rare choice made by rare people willing to be friends with me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I see, that was super rude! Going to apologize properly right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So, farewell for today!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Good-luck daaaash!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah! To clear my head. Great idea!
Off I go for quick run!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!
Phew!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Running full blast cleared random thoughts! Mind and body refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thought about it while running, going to talk properly tonight!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, for change of pace...!
Off I go for quick run!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!
Pheeew...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, overthinking just made thoughts spin round and round...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mind totally unsettled! Uuuugh, in that case!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmmm~,
eco eco azarach, eco eco ottosei...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Chanting mysterious incantation, pulled pencil from nowhere and rolled it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm, 'Showing sincerity brings good luck'.
I knew it... gotta apologize properly first!
